SQLite 的公有领域声明（随源码分发时保留本文件）
=========================================================================

权威原文：https://sqlite.org/copyright.html
（本文件为誊录，便于离线/仓库内自查；如有出入以官网为准）

The SQLite Source Code is in the public domain.

All of the deliverable code in SQLite has been dedicated to the public
domain by the authors.  All code authors, and representatives of the
companies they work for, have signed affidavits dedicating their
contributions to the public domain and originals of those signed
affidavits are stored in a firesafe at the main offices of Hwaci.
Anyone is free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, or
distribute the original SQLite code, either in source code form or as a
compiled binary, for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, and by
any means.

All of the deliverable code in SQLite has been written from scratch.
No code has been taken from other projects or from the open internet.
Every line of code can be traced back to its original author, so the
authors own the copyright on their code, and this project does not have
to comply with the LGPL, MIT, or other similar terms.

The author disclaims copyright to this source code.  In place of a
legal notice, here is a blessing:

   May you do good and not evil.
   May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
   May you share freely, never taking more than you give.
